question: Reconcile first nine open headers with current providers and previous ownership evidence.
procedure: Read the nine current headers, associated earlier receipts, and P102/P103 delivered native-provider extractions. Replace obsolete generic next_check text; retain all open statuses.

items.decision: Original CSR capture declarations and tag macros use C types; reconcile original header in S14. CsrPortHeap allocation/retirement belongs to S13 product lifetime. No wholesale move to B.

P102 already moved path conversion to B. Remaining header contains original section-image ABI, classifier declarations, suffix storage references and bindings. Reconcile original declarations and build bindings, not duplicate the B path provider.

Original CSR/BaseClient message declarations remain C-shaped; S14 declaration recovery. S13 retains authenticated client transport and capture validation. B console-handle predicate is already delivered.

P103 already moved immutable config carrier and reads to B. Remaining D header adds original BaseGetVdmConfigInfo declaration and FULL_INFO_BUFFER_SIZE using C KEY_VALUE_FULL_INFORMATION. Reconcile original declaration owner; do not repeat config migration.

Per-translation-unit _X86_ selection after native nt.h deliberately enables DOS/OS2 NE classification on AMD64. Preserve actual guest classification while resolving build/header ownership; not a generic B architecture selector.

Redirector prepare/complete/release bind worker-owned request staging and epoch. Preserve payload commit before error/count and release of PrivateAsyncState. Declaration relocation alone cannot eliminate the F call.

Guest page-domain publication, callback context and exact-generation borrowed views belong to current worker lifetime. Preserve original SetSysColors success ordering; do not create independent B guest state.
Directory queries already B; mixed header still declares worker-owned SYSTEM.INI shadow staging. Resolve staging input/lifetime with wkernel consumer; no wholesale move of mixed header into B.

Service owns trusted interactive LUID and scoped request binding; original C token-query algorithm remains. S13 settles admission policy boundary, S14 original token declarations. Do not move admission policy wholesale into B.

limitations: These are execution dispositions, not approval for new mirror differences.
Mixed header removal is not proved by moving only its native helper.
No product source, build, package or guest changed. No new runtime validation claimed.
